name: Seutas Pita Merah
source:
HIV/AIDS is often still considered a taboo topic, hence the low awareness. To cope with this matter, Health Promotion Division under the Ministry of Health Indonesia wanted to create a fun platform to educate especially young people about HIV/AIDS. 

Seutas Pita Merah, is a visual novel game with moving story about how to cope with the whole HIV/AIDS . The player will take the role as Maya/Angga, a student that has just graduated from high school whose approaching an HIV/AIDS-infected friend. The game is also enhanced with the presence of HIV/AIDS expertise to guide players on learning about the disease. 

[Taken from Official site]
translation:
HIV/AIDS至今仍常被视为禁忌话题，因此大众对它的认知度很低。为了应对这一问题，印度尼西亚卫生部健康促进司希望创建一个有趣的平台，尤其用于向年轻人普及HIV/AIDS知识。

《一条红丝带》是一部剧情丰富的视觉小说游戏，讲述如何面对HIV/AIDS。玩家将扮演玛雅或安加，一名刚高中毕业、正在接近一位感染HIV/AIDS的朋友的学生。游戏还邀请HIV/AIDS专家指导玩家学习相关疾病知识。
